working_definition: Author type 'T5d' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: T5 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 4 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a downwards direction (Henning et al., 2022).

justification: 'T5d' is the exact label or an exact synonym of FBbt:00003740 'T5d neuron'.
